```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America condemns the brutal crimes of the September 11th terrorist attacks.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The victims of the September 11th tragedy require effective justice, not politically motivated hyperbole.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All perpetrators of these criminal acts must be brought before the bar of justice.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Progressives and progressive elected officials must demand that all proposals be based on proven need rather than emotional excess.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There can be no doubt that more effective anti-terrorist measures, including more effective intelligence gathering, better security measures, and policing of the skies, are necessary.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Sadly, emotional excess has already resulted in attacks against Americans of the Islamic and Sikh faiths.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Few have been spared the agony of some personal connection to the pain and anguish caused to those who have lost family or friends.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Our hearts are with all who have lost loved ones and colleagues.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In the days and weeks ahead, identities of those who perished will begin to be learned, compounding the shock of the terrible images.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Television screens have been filled with pundits of the right pushing their agenda of increased military spending and diminished civil liberties.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
